known_limitations: Both local sandbox backends remain application/process-level foundations and are not operating-system security boundaries
ControlPlane and LocalRunner are separate code responsibilities but still run in one process with the same host identity
SQLite leases coordinate only local workers and do not provide remote authentication or distributed queue semantics
Cancellation is cooperative and prevents a not-yet-started action but cannot terminate an adapter process tree already in progress
LocalProcessSandboxBackend process-group cleanup is best effort, especially on Windows without Job Objects
Network deny requests are recorded but unenforced without an OS or container network boundary
Evidence event chains and local-development attestations are unsigned and do not provide authorship, non-repudiation, immutable storage, or trusted timestamps
A filesystem writer who recomputes the complete chain, attestation, and manifest can create a new internally consistent unsigned bundle
Jobs interrupted during an effectful phase require operator-reviewed recovery; automatic rollback is not implemented
The symlink escape test could not create a Windows symlink without elevated privilege; link and reparse-point refusal code remains active
Only UTF-8 text mutation is supported; binary files are metadata-only
Validation adapters support only explicitly allowlisted local argv
Dependency installation is disabled by default
Deletion, merge, force-push, deployment, and credential operations are prohibited
Remote Git push and localhost Streamable HTTP were not exercised end to end in this checkpoint
No public MCP endpoint, remote authentication, or ChatGPT Web connection has been implemented or tested
The adapter registry contains only reviewed built-ins; dynamic plugin loading, package trust, upgrade negotiation, and domain-specific adapters are not implemented
Contract schemas are descriptive in-process compatibility metadata; remaining service and MCP request/response envelopes are not independently version-negotiated
